title: IdempotencyRecord
description: Persisted outcome of a command, keyed by (projectId, actorId, route, key). A replay with the same requestHash returns the stored status and body verbatim. A replay with a different requestHash is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the caller reused a key for a different command, which is a client bug and must never be answered with the first command's result.

responseBody.description: Stored verbatim and replayed. Null while the command is still in flight.

inFlight.description: True until the command commits; a concurrent replay is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS rather than a duplicate execution.
